title: SIDESTORY: HORTUS DE ESCAPISMO RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: HORTUS DE ESCAPISMO RERUN
DURATION: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Hortus de Escapismo event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Sanctilaminium Ambrosii]
Duration: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 3, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Sacrarium Derelictum]
Duration: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 3, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Secretae Continere]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by completing missions in [Secretae Continere].
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Insider], Ambulacrum Ambrosii (Pieces), Module Materials, Holy Statue Fragments, etc.
[Convivia Cenarum Localia]
DURATION: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Holy Statue Fragments] by clearing event stages. [Holy Statue Fragments] can be used to redeem items from [Convivia Cenarum Localia].
REWARDS: Insider's token, Ambulacrum Ambrosii (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Skill Summary, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Executor the Ex Foedere, Spuria, and Insider will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be available in [Side Story] from January 7, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ARBITER AEQUISSIMUS
DURATION: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Arbiter Aequissimus], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Executor the Ex Foedere
★★★★★: Spuria / Cantabile

NOTE: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 RHODES KITCHEN COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Rhodes Kitchen Collection - Sweet Jackpot for Insider
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – AMBULACRUM AMBROSII
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Ambulacrum Ambrosii will be available.
This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Hortus de Escapismo event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: December 24, 2024, 10:00 - January 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
